ko.title: 오만 해역의 유조선 피격과 테헤란의 대표단: 호르무즈 휴전이 여전히 요원한 이유

segments.src: ## A Fragile Diplomatic Window, Shattered Within Hours
segments.tr: ## 몇 시간 만에 산산조각난 취약한 외교적 기회

segments.src: Just hours after a Pakistani delegation concluded a fresh round of talks in Tehran aimed at ending nearly six months of conflict around the Strait of Hormuz, another commercial tanker was struck off the coast of Oman.
segments.tr: 파키스탄 대표단이 호르무즈 해협 주변에서 거의 6개월간 이어져 온 분쟁을 종식하기 위해 테헤란에서 새로운 회담을 마무리한 지 불과 몇 시간 만에, 오만 해안 인근에서 또 다른 상선 유조선이 피격되었습니다.

segments.src: The timing was jarring: diplomats had barely left the room before the waterway reminded the world why a durable ceasefire remains elusive.
segments.tr: 시기가 묘했습니다. 외교관들이 회의실을 떠나기 무섭게 해협은 왜 지속 가능한 휴전이 여전히 어려운지 세상에 일깨워주었습니다.

segments.src: According to shipping-industry monitors and regional officials, the vessel was transiting international waters near Omani territory when it sustained damage consistent with previous attacks reported in the strait over recent months.
segments.tr: 해운 업계 모니터링 기관과 지역 관리들에 따르면, 해당 선박은 오만 영해 근처의 공해상을 항해하던 중 최근 몇 달간 해협에서 보고된 이전의 공격들과 유사한 피해를 입었습니다.

segments.src: No group has been formally confirmed as responsible, and assessments of the incident are still being verified by maritime security firms and flag-state authorities.
segments.tr: 공식적으로 배후를 자처한 단체는 아직 확인되지 않았으며, 사건에 대한 평가는 해상 보안 업체와 기국 당국에 의해 여전히 검증되고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## 해협이 그토록 중요한 이유

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most critical chokepoints, with a large share of globally traded crude oil and liquefied natural gas passing through its narrow channel every day.
segments.tr: 호르무즈 해협은 전 세계에서 가장 중요한 초입 병목 지역 중 하나로, 매일 전 세계에서 거래되는 원유와 액화천연가스의 상당 부분이 이 좁은 해상을 통과합니다.

segments.src: Even the perception of heightened risk there tends to ripple outward — nudging up tanker insurance premiums, prompting shipping lines to reroute or pause transits, and adding volatility to energy markets far from the Gulf itself.
segments.tr: 그곳에서 위험이 커졌다는 인식만으로도 파장이 일기 쉽습니다. 유조선 보험료가 오르고, 해운사들이 항로를 우회하거나 운항을 일시 중단하며, 페르시아만 자체와는 거리가 먼 에너지 시장에 변동성을 더하게 됩니다.

segments.src: That is part of why, six months into the conflict, regional and international actors have kept pushing for a negotiated de-escalation even as fighting continues.
segments.tr: 분쟁이 6개월째 접어들면서도 지역 및 국제 행위자들이 전투가 지속되는 와중에도 협상을 통한 긴장 완화를 계속 추진하는 이유가 바로 여기에 있습니다.

segments.src: A prolonged disruption to Hormuz traffic carries costs that extend well beyond the countries directly involved.
segments.tr: 호르무즈 해협 통항의 장기적인 차단은 직접 관련된 국가들을 훨씬 넘어선 비용을 초래합니다.

segments.src: ## Islamabad's Quiet Mediation Role
segments.tr: ## 이슬라마바드의 조용한 중재 역할

segments.src: Pakistan's involvement reflects its unusual position: it maintains working relationships with multiple parties to the conflict and has domestic economic incentives — from energy imports to regional trade routes — in seeing the crisis contained.
segments.tr: 파키스탄의 개입은 그 특이한 입장을 반영합니다. 파키스탄은 분쟁의 여러 당사국과 실무 관계를 유지하고 있으며, 에너지 수입부터 지역 무역로에 이르기까지 위기가 통제되는 것을 볼 수 있는 국내 경제적 동기를 가지고 있습니다.

segments.src: The Tehran talks were described by people familiar with the discussions as focused on confidence-building measures rather than a comprehensive settlement: steps such as protected shipping corridors, communication hotlines to prevent miscalculation, and a phased de-escalation framework.
segments.tr: 테헤란 회담에 정통한 사람들은 이번 회담이 포괄적인 합의보다는 신뢰 구축 조치, 즉 보호된 해상 회랑, 오인 방지를 위한 통신 핫라인, 단계별 긴장 완화 프레임워크와 같은 조치들에 초점을 맞추었다고 전했습니다.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in similar past mediation efforts caution that this kind of shuttle diplomacy rarely produces an immediate breakthrough.
segments.tr: 유사한 과거 중재 노력에 참여했던 외교관들은 이러한 종류의 셔틀 외교가 즉각적인 돌파구를 마련하는 경우는 드물다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: Instead, it tends to lay groundwork — testing whether the parties are willing to accept even limited, verifiable steps before broader negotiations become possible.
segments.tr: 대신 이는 토대를 닦는 경향이 있습니다. 더 광범위한 협상이 가능해지기 전에 당사국들이 제한적이고 검증 가능한 조치조차 받아들일 의향이 있는지 시험해 보는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The Gap Between the Table and the Water
segments.tr: ## 회담 테이블과 바다 사이의 괴리

segments.src: The tanker strike underscores a persistent problem in conflicts fought partly at sea: control over irregular or proxy actors is often looser than it is on land, and a single incident can undercut weeks of diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: 이번 유조선 피격은 부분적으로 해상에서 벌어지는 분쟁의 고질적인 문제를 여실히 보여줍니다. 비정규군이나 대리 세력에 대한 통제는 육상에서보다 느슨한 경우가 많으며, 단 한 번의 사건으로도 수주간의 외교적 기반이 흔들릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts tracking the conflict note that attacks near shipping lanes have repeatedly coincided with periods of active negotiation, raising questions about whether all relevant factions are equally committed to a pause — or whether some see continued pressure on shipping as useful leverage at the table.
segments.tr: 분쟁을 추적하는 분석가들은 해상 통로 근처의 공격이 활발한 협상 시기와 반복적으로 겹쳤다는 점에 주목하며, 관련 모든 진영이 휴전에 진정으로 전념하고 있는지, 아니면 일부 진영이 해운에 대한 지속적인 압박을 협상 테이블에서의 유용한 지렛대로 보고 있는지에 대한 의문을 제기하고 있습니다.

segments.src: For now, maritime authorities have reiterated advisories urging vessels transiting the strait to maintain heightened vigilance, follow recommended security corridors, and report any unusual activity promptly.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 해사 당국이 해협을 통과하는 선박들에게 경계 태세를 강화하고, 권장되는 보안 회랑을 준수하며, 이상 징후를 신속하게 보고할 것을 촉구하는 권고를 거듭 재확인했습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks have not announced a timeline for a follow-up round, though regional diplomats suggest further contacts are likely given the economic stakes for all sides.
segments.tr: 회담에 참여한 관계자들은 후속 회담 일정에 대해 발표하지 않았지만, 지역 외교관들은 모든 당사자들의 경제적 이해관계를 고려할 때 추가 접촉이 이루어질 가능성이 높다고 시사합니다.

segments.src: Markets and shipping firms, meanwhile, are left watching an uneasy space between negotiation and disruption — where progress in Tehran's meeting rooms has yet to translate into calm on the water.
segments.tr: 한편 시장과 해운사들은 협상과 혼란 사이의 불안정한 공간을 지켜볼 수밖에 없는 상황입니다. 테헤란 회의실에서의 진전이 아직 바다 위의 평온으로 이어지지 않은 상태입니다.

segments.src: Until that gap closes, incidents like the latest strike off Oman are likely to remain a recurring test of whether the six-month conflict is nearing an end or simply entering its next uncertain phase.
segments.tr: 그 간극이 좁혀질 때까지, 오만 인근의 최근 피격과 같은 사건들은 6개월간의 분쟁이 종식을 향해 가고 있는지 아니면 단순히 다음 불확실한 국면으로 접어들고 있는지 보여주는 반복적인 시험대가 될 것입니다.

zh.title: 阿曼海域油轮遇袭，德黑兰代表团会谈：为何霍尔木兹海峡停火仍遥遥无期

segments.src: ## A Fragile Diplomatic Window, Shattered Within Hours
segments.tr: ## 脆弱的外交窗口，数小时内破碎

segments.src: Just hours after a Pakistani delegation concluded a fresh round of talks in Tehran aimed at ending nearly six months of conflict around the Strait of Hormuz, another commercial tanker was struck off the coast of Oman.
segments.tr: 就在巴基斯坦代表团结束在德黑兰新一轮旨在结束霍尔木兹海峡周边近六个月冲突的会谈后仅数小时，阿曼海岸外又有一艘商用油轮遭到袭击。

segments.src: The timing was jarring: diplomats had barely left the room before the waterway reminded the world why a durable ceasefire remains elusive.
segments.tr: 时机之巧令人震惊：外交官们刚离开会议室，这条水道就再次提醒世界，为何持久停火依然难以实现。

segments.src: According to shipping-industry monitors and regional officials, the vessel was transiting international waters near Omani territory when it sustained damage consistent with previous attacks reported in the strait over recent months.
segments.tr: 据航运业监测机构和地区官员称，该船在阿曼领土附近的国际水域航行时受损，其受损情况与近几个月在该海峡报告的其他袭击事件一致。

segments.src: No group has been formally confirmed as responsible, and assessments of the incident are still being verified by maritime security firms and flag-state authorities.
segments.tr: 目前尚未有任何组织被正式确认为责任方，海事安全公司和船旗国当局仍在核实事件评估。

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## 为什么霍尔木兹海峡如此重要

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most critical chokepoints, with a large share of globally traded crude oil and liquefied natural gas passing through its narrow channel every day.
segments.tr: 霍尔木兹海峡是世界上最重要的咽喉要道之一，全球很大一部分原油和液化天然气每天都要通过其狭窄的航道。

segments.src: Even the perception of heightened risk there tends to ripple outward — nudging up tanker insurance premiums, prompting shipping lines to reroute or pause transits, and adding volatility to energy markets far from the Gulf itself.
segments.tr: 即使是该地区风险升高的迹象，也往往会产生连锁反应——推高油轮保险费，促使航运公司改道或暂停航行，并给远离海湾地区的能源市场带来波动。

segments.src: That is part of why, six months into the conflict, regional and international actors have kept pushing for a negotiated de-escalation even as fighting continues.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么在冲突持续六个月后，尽管战斗仍在继续，地区和国际参与者仍不断推动谈判以实现局势降温。

segments.src: A prolonged disruption to Hormuz traffic carries costs that extend well beyond the countries directly involved.
segments.tr: 霍尔木兹海峡交通的长期中断所带来的代价，远远超出了直接相关国家的范围。

segments.src: ## Islamabad's Quiet Mediation Role
segments.tr: ## 伊斯兰堡的低调斡旋角色

segments.src: Pakistan's involvement reflects its unusual position: it maintains working relationships with multiple parties to the conflict and has domestic economic incentives — from energy imports to regional trade routes — in seeing the crisis contained.
segments.tr: 巴基斯坦的参与反映了其独特的地位：它与冲突的多方保持着工作关系，并且有国内经济动机——从能源进口到区域贸易路线——来确保危机得到控制。

segments.src: The Tehran talks were described by people familiar with the discussions as focused on confidence-building measures rather than a comprehensive settlement: steps such as protected shipping corridors, communication hotlines to prevent miscalculation, and a phased de-escalation framework.
segments.tr: 据熟悉讨论情况的人士称，德黑兰会谈的重点是建立信任措施，而非达成全面解决方案：例如建立受保护的航运走廊、防止误判的通信热线以及分阶段的降温框架。

segments.src: Diplomats involved in similar past mediation efforts caution that this kind of shuttle diplomacy rarely produces an immediate breakthrough.
segments.tr: 参与过类似过去斡旋努力的外交官们提醒说，这种穿梭外交很少能立即取得突破。

segments.src: Instead, it tends to lay groundwork — testing whether the parties are willing to accept even limited, verifiable steps before broader negotiations become possible.
segments.tr: 相反，它往往是在打基础——在进行更广泛的谈判之前，测试各方是否愿意接受哪怕是有限的、可核实的步骤。

segments.src: ## The Gap Between the Table and the Water
segments.tr: ## 谈判桌与海面之间的鸿沟

segments.src: The tanker strike underscores a persistent problem in conflicts fought partly at sea: control over irregular or proxy actors is often looser than it is on land, and a single incident can undercut weeks of diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: 油轮遇袭凸显了部分海上冲突的一个持续性问题：对非正规武装或代理人的控制往往比在陆地上更松散，单一事件就可能破坏数周的外交努力。

segments.src: Analysts tracking the conflict note that attacks near shipping lanes have repeatedly coincided with periods of active negotiation, raising questions about whether all relevant factions are equally committed to a pause — or whether some see continued pressure on shipping as useful leverage at the table.
segments.tr: 追踪该冲突的分析人士指出，航道附近的袭击一再与积极谈判的时期重合，这引发了人们的质疑：所有相关派系是否都同样致力于停火，或者某些派系是否将持续的航运压力视为谈判桌上的有用筹码。

segments.src: For now, maritime authorities have reiterated advisories urging vessels transiting the strait to maintain heightened vigilance, follow recommended security corridors, and report any unusual activity promptly.
segments.tr: 目前，海事当局已重申建议，敦促通过该海峡的船只保持高度警惕，遵循建议的安全走廊，并及时报告任何异常活动。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks have not announced a timeline for a follow-up round, though regional diplomats suggest further contacts are likely given the economic stakes for all sides.
segments.tr: 参与会谈的官员尚未宣布后续会谈的时间表，但地区外交官认为，考虑到各方的经济利益，未来很可能会有进一步的接触。

segments.src: Markets and shipping firms, meanwhile, are left watching an uneasy space between negotiation and disruption — where progress in Tehran's meeting rooms has yet to translate into calm on the water.
segments.tr: 与此同时，市场和航运公司只能在谈判与中断之间的不安空间中观望——德黑兰会议室取得的进展尚未转化为海面上的平静。

segments.src: Until that gap closes, incidents like the latest strike off Oman are likely to remain a recurring test of whether the six-month conflict is nearing an end or simply entering its next uncertain phase.
segments.tr: 在这一鸿沟弥合之前，像阿曼海域最近这次袭击这样的事件，很可能会继续成为考验这场六个月的冲突是接近尾声，还是仅仅进入下一个不确定阶段的试金石。

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## यह जलडमरूमध्य इतना महत्वपूर्ण क्यों है

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most critical chokepoints, with a large share of globally traded crude oil and liquefied natural gas passing through its narrow channel every day.
segments.tr: होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य दुनिया के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण चोकपॉइंट्स में से एक है, जिसके संकीर्ण चैनल से हर दिन वैश्विक स्तर पर व्यापार किए जाने वाले कच्चे तेल और तरल प्राकृतिक गैस का एक बड़ा हिस्सा गुजरता है।

segments.src: Even the perception of heightened risk there tends to ripple outward — nudging up tanker insurance premiums, prompting shipping lines to reroute or pause transits, and adding volatility to energy markets far from the Gulf itself.
segments.tr: वहां बढ़ते जोखिम की सिर्फ धारणा भी बाहर तक असर डालती है — टैंकर बीमा प्रीमियम बढ़ाती है, शिपिंग लाइनों को मार्ग बदलने या पारगमन रोकने के लिए प्रेरित करती है, और खाड़ी से दूर ऊर्जा बाजारों में अस्थिरता जोड़ती है।

segments.src: That is part of why, six months into the conflict, regional and international actors have kept pushing for a negotiated de-escalation even as fighting continues.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि संघर्ष के छह महीने बीत जाने के बाद भी, लड़ाई जारी रहने के बावजूद क्षेत्रीय और अंतरराष्ट्रीय कलाकार एक बातचीत के जरिए तनाव कम करने के लिए दबाव बनाते रहे हैं।

segments.src: A prolonged disruption to Hormuz traffic carries costs that extend well beyond the countries directly involved.
segments.tr: होर्मुज यातायात में लंबे समय तक व्यवधान से ऐसी लागतें जुड़ी हैं जो सीधे तौर पर शामिल देशों से कहीं आगे तक जाती हैं।

segments.src: ## Islamabad's Quiet Mediation Role
segments.tr: ## इस्लामाबाद की शांत मध्यस्थता भूमिका

segments.src: Pakistan's involvement reflects its unusual position: it maintains working relationships with multiple parties to the conflict and has domestic economic incentives — from energy imports to regional trade routes — in seeing the crisis contained.
segments.tr: पाकिस्तान की भागीदारी उसकी असामान्य स्थिति को दर्शाती है: यह संघर्ष के कई पक्षों के साथ कामकाजी संबंध बनाए रखता है और संकट को नियंत्रित करने में उसके घरेलू आर्थिक हित शामिल हैं — ऊर्जा आयात से लेकर क्षेत्रीय व्यापार मार्गों तक।

segments.src: The Tehran talks were described by people familiar with the discussions as focused on confidence-building measures rather than a comprehensive settlement: steps such as protected shipping corridors, communication hotlines to prevent miscalculation, and a phased de-escalation framework.
segments.tr: चर्चाओं से परिचित लोगों द्वारा तेहरान वार्ता को एक व्यापक समझौते के बजाय विश्वास-निर्माण के उपायों पर केंद्रित बताया गया था: जैसे संरक्षित शिपिंग गलियारे, गलतफहमी को रोकने के लिए संचार हॉटलाइन, और एक चरणबद्ध तनाव-कम करने का ढांचा।

segments.src: Diplomats involved in similar past mediation efforts caution that this kind of shuttle diplomacy rarely produces an immediate breakthrough.
segments.tr: इसी तरह के पिछले मध्यस्थता प्रयासों में शामिल कूटनीतिज्ञ चेतावनी देते हैं कि इस तरह की शटल कूटनीति शायद ही कभी तत्काल सफलता दिलाती है।

segments.src: Instead, it tends to lay groundwork — testing whether the parties are willing to accept even limited, verifiable steps before broader negotiations become possible.

segments.src: ## The Gap Between the Table and the Water

segments.tr: टैंकर पर हमला आंशिक रूप से समुद्र में लड़े जाने वाले संघर्षों में एक लगातार बनी रहने वाली समस्या को रेखांकित करता है: अनियमित या प्रॉक्सी अभिनेताओं पर नियंत्रण अक्सर जमीन की तुलना में ढीला होता है, और एक एकल घटना हफ्तों के कूटनीतिक प्रयासों को कमजोर कर सकती है।

segments.src: Analysts tracking the conflict note that attacks near shipping lanes have repeatedly coincided with periods of active negotiation, raising questions about whether all relevant factions are equally committed to a pause — or whether some see continued pressure on shipping as useful leverage at the table.
segments.tr: संघर्ष पर नजर रखने वाले विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि शिपिंग लेन के पास हमले बार-बार सक्रिय बातचीत की अवधि के साथ मेल खाते हैं, जिससे यह सवाल उठता है कि क्या सभी प्रासंगिक गुट विराम के लिए समान रूप से प्रतिबद्ध हैं — या क्या कुछ लोग शिपिंग पर निरंतर दबाव को मेज पर उपयोगी लाभ के रूप में देखते हैं।

segments.src: For now, maritime authorities have reiterated advisories urging vessels transiting the strait to maintain heightened vigilance, follow recommended security corridors, and report any unusual activity promptly.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, समुद्री अधिकारियों ने परामर्श दोहराया है जिसमें जलडमरूमध्य से गुजरने वाले जहाजों से अत्यधिक सतर्कता बनाए रखने, अनुशंसित सुरक्षा गलियारों का पालन करने और किसी भी असामान्य गतिविधि की तुरंत रिपोर्ट करने का आग्रह किया गया है।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks have not announced a timeline for a follow-up round, though regional diplomats suggest further contacts are likely given the economic stakes for all sides.
segments.tr: वार्ता में शामिल अधिकारियों ने अगले दौर के लिए किसी समय सीमा की घोषणा नहीं की है, हालांकि क्षेत्रीय राजनयिकों का सुझाव है कि सभी पक्षों के लिए दांव पर लगे आर्थिक हितों को देखते हुए आगे के संपर्क की संभावना है।

segments.src: Markets and shipping firms, meanwhile, are left watching an uneasy space between negotiation and disruption — where progress in Tehran's meeting rooms has yet to translate into calm on the water.
segments.tr: इस बीच, बाजार और शिपिंग फर्म बातचीत और व्यवधान के बीच एक असहज स्थिति को देख रहे हैं — जहां तेहरान के बैठक कक्षों में प्रगति अभी तक पानी पर शांति में नहीं बदली है।

segments.tr: जब तक वह खाई बंद नहीं हो जाती, ओमान के तट पर ताजा हमले जैसी घटनाएं यह परखने की बार-बार परीक्षा बनी रहने की संभावना है कि क्या छह महीने का संघर्ष समाप्ति के करीब है या बस अपने अगले अनिश्चित चरण में प्रवेश कर रहा है।

es.title: Un ataque a un petrolero frente a Omán y una delegación en Teherán: por qué un alto el fuego en Ormuz sigue estando lejos

fr.title: Une attaque de pétrolier au large d'Oman, une délégation à Téhéran : pourquoi un cessez-le-feu dans le détroit d'Ormuz reste lointain

segments.src: ## A Fragile Diplomatic Window, Shattered Within Hours
segments.tr: ## Une fenêtre diplomatique fragile, brisée en quelques heures

segments.src: Just hours after a Pakistani delegation concluded a fresh round of talks in Tehran aimed at ending nearly six months of conflict around the Strait of Hormuz, another commercial tanker was struck off the coast of Oman.
segments.tr: Quelques heures seulement après qu'une délégation pakistanaise a conclu une nouvelle série de pourparlers à Téhéran visant à mettre fin à près de six mois de conflit autour du détroit d'Ormuz, un autre pétrolier commercial a été frappé au large des côtes d'Oman.

segments.src: The timing was jarring: diplomats had barely left the room before the waterway reminded the world why a durable ceasefire remains elusive.
segments.tr: Le timing était déconcertant : les diplomates avaient à peine quitté la salle que la voie navigable rappelait au monde pourquoi un cessez-le-feu durable reste insaisissable.

segments.src: According to shipping-industry monitors and regional officials, the vessel was transiting international waters near Omani territory when it sustained damage consistent with previous attacks reported in the strait over recent months.
segments.tr: Selon les observateurs de l'industrie maritime et les responsables régionaux, le navire transitait dans les eaux internationales près du territoire omanais lorsqu'il a subi des dommages cohérents avec les attaques précédentes signalées dans le détroit au cours des derniers mois.

segments.src: No group has been formally confirmed as responsible, and assessments of the incident are still being verified by maritime security firms and flag-state authorities.
segments.tr: Aucun groupe n'a été officiellement désigné comme responsable, et les évaluations de l'incident sont encore en cours de vérification par les sociétés de sécurité maritime et les autorités de l'État du pavillon.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le détroit est si important

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most critical chokepoints, with a large share of globally traded crude oil and liquefied natural gas passing through its narrow channel every day.
segments.tr: Le détroit d'Ormuz est l'un des points de passage les plus critiques au monde, avec une grande partie du pétrole brut et du gaz naturel liquéfié échangés mondialement qui transitent chaque jour par son canal étroit.

segments.src: Even the perception of heightened risk there tends to ripple outward — nudging up tanker insurance premiums, prompting shipping lines to reroute or pause transits, and adding volatility to energy markets far from the Gulf itself.
segments.tr: Même la perception d'un risque accru à cet endroit tend à se répercuter à l'extérieur — faisant grimper les primes d'assurance des pétroliers, incitant les compagnies maritimes à modifier leurs itinéraires ou à suspendre leurs transits, et ajoutant de la volatilité aux marchés de l'énergie loin du Golfe lui-même.

segments.src: That is part of why, six months into the conflict, regional and international actors have kept pushing for a negotiated de-escalation even as fighting continues.
segments.tr: C'est en partie pourquoi, six mois après le début du conflit, les acteurs régionaux et internationaux continuent de faire pression pour une désescalade négociée, même si les combats se poursuivent.

segments.src: A prolonged disruption to Hormuz traffic carries costs that extend well beyond the countries directly involved.
segments.tr: Une perturbation prolongée du trafic dans le détroit d'Ormuz entraîne des coûts qui vont bien au-delà des pays directement impliqués.

segments.src: ## Islamabad's Quiet Mediation Role
segments.tr: ## Le rôle discret de médiation d'Islamabad

segments.src: Pakistan's involvement reflects its unusual position: it maintains working relationships with multiple parties to the conflict and has domestic economic incentives — from energy imports to regional trade routes — in seeing the crisis contained.
segments.tr: L'implication du Pakistan reflète sa position inhabituelle : il entretient des relations de travail avec plusieurs parties au conflit et a des incitations économiques nationales — des importations d'énergie aux routes commerciales régionales — à voir la crise contenue.

segments.src: The Tehran talks were described by people familiar with the discussions as focused on confidence-building measures rather than a comprehensive settlement: steps such as protected shipping corridors, communication hotlines to prevent miscalculation, and a phased de-escalation framework.
segments.tr: Les pourparlers de Téhéran ont été décrits par des personnes proches des discussions comme étant axés sur des mesures de confiance plutôt que sur un règlement global : des mesures telles que des corridors maritimes protégés, des lignes directes de communication pour éviter les erreurs de calcul et un cadre de désescalade progressive.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in similar past mediation efforts caution that this kind of shuttle diplomacy rarely produces an immediate breakthrough.
segments.tr: Les diplomates impliqués dans des efforts de médiation similaires par le passé préviennent que ce type de diplomatie de navette produit rarement une percée immédiate.

segments.src: Instead, it tends to lay groundwork — testing whether the parties are willing to accept even limited, verifiable steps before broader negotiations become possible.
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, elle tend à jeter les bases — en testant si les parties sont prêtes à accepter des mesures limitées et vérifiables avant que des négociations plus larges ne deviennent possibles.

segments.src: ## The Gap Between the Table and the Water
segments.tr: ## Le fossé entre la table des négociations et l'eau

segments.src: The tanker strike underscores a persistent problem in conflicts fought partly at sea: control over irregular or proxy actors is often looser than it is on land, and a single incident can undercut weeks of diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: L'attaque du pétrolier souligne un problème persistant dans les conflits menés en partie en mer : le contrôle sur les acteurs irréguliers ou par procuration est souvent plus lâche qu'il ne l'est sur terre, et un seul incident peut saper des semaines de travail diplomatique.

segments.src: Analysts tracking the conflict note that attacks near shipping lanes have repeatedly coincided with periods of active negotiation, raising questions about whether all relevant factions are equally committed to a pause — or whether some see continued pressure on shipping as useful leverage at the table.
segments.tr: Les analystes qui suivent le conflit notent que les attaques près des voies de navigation ont coïncidé à plusieurs reprises avec des périodes de négociation active, soulevant des questions sur la question de savoir si toutes les factions concernées sont également engagées dans une pause — ou si certaines considèrent la pression continue sur le transport maritime comme un levier utile à la table des négociations.

segments.src: For now, maritime authorities have reiterated advisories urging vessels transiting the strait to maintain heightened vigilance, follow recommended security corridors, and report any unusual activity promptly.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les autorités maritimes ont réitéré leurs avis exhortant les navires transitant par le détroit à maintenir une vigilance accrue, à suivre les corridors de sécurité recommandés et à signaler rapidement toute activité inhabituelle.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks have not announced a timeline for a follow-up round, though regional diplomats suggest further contacts are likely given the economic stakes for all sides.
segments.tr: Les responsables impliqués dans les pourparlers n'ont pas annoncé de calendrier pour une série de suivi, bien que les diplomates régionaux suggèrent que d'autres contacts sont probables compte tenu des enjeux économiques pour toutes les parties.

segments.src: Markets and shipping firms, meanwhile, are left watching an uneasy space between negotiation and disruption — where progress in Tehran's meeting rooms has yet to translate into calm on the water.
segments.tr: Les marchés et les compagnies maritimes, quant à eux, sont laissés à observer un espace inconfortable entre la négociation et la perturbation — où les progrès réalisés dans les salles de réunion de Téhéran n'ont pas encore été traduits par un calme sur l'eau.

segments.src: Until that gap closes, incidents like the latest strike off Oman are likely to remain a recurring test of whether the six-month conflict is nearing an end or simply entering its next uncertain phase.
segments.tr: Jusqu'à ce que ce fossé soit comblé, des incidents comme la dernière attaque au large d'Oman resteront probablement un test récurrent pour savoir si le conflit de six mois touche à sa fin ou s'il entre simplement dans sa prochaine phase incertaine.

segments.src: Even the perception of heightened risk there tends to ripple outward — nudging up tanker insurance premiums, prompting shipping lines to reroute or pause transits, and adding volatility to energy markets far from the Gulf itself.

segments.src: That is part of why, six months into the conflict, regional and international actors have kept pushing for a negotiated de-escalation even as fighting continues.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters So Much

segments.tr: Thời điểm xảy ra vụ việc thật đáng kinh ngạc: các nhà ngoại giao vừa rời phòng họp thì tuyến đường thủy này đã nhắc nhở thế giới lý do tại sao một lệnh ngừng bắn bền vững vẫn còn là điều khó nắm bắt.

segments.src: According to shipping-industry monitors and regional officials, the vessel was transiting international waters near Omani territory when it sustained damage consistent with previous attacks reported in the strait over recent months.
segments.tr: Theo các đơn vị giám sát ngành vận tải biển và các quan chức khu vực, con tàu đang đi qua vùng biển quốc tế gần lãnh thổ Oman thì bị hư hại tương tự như các cuộc tấn công trước đó được báo cáo tại eo biển này trong những tháng gần đây.

segments.src: No group has been formally confirmed as responsible, and assessments of the incident are still being verified by maritime security firms and flag-state authorities.
segments.tr: Chưa có nhóm nào chính thức xác nhận chịu trách nhiệm và các đánh giá về vụ việc vẫn đang được các công ty an ninh hàng hải và chính quyền quốc gia treo cờ xác minh.

segments.src: ## Why the Strait Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## Tại sao eo biển này lại quan trọng đến vậy

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most critical chokepoints, with a large share of globally traded crude oil and liquefied natural gas passing through its narrow channel every day.
segments.tr: Eo biển Hormuz là một trong những điểm nghẽn quan trọng nhất thế giới, với một phần lớn dầu thô và khí đốt tự nhiên hóa lỏng được giao dịch toàn cầu đi qua kênh hẹp này mỗi ngày.

segments.src: Even the perception of heightened risk there tends to ripple outward — nudging up tanker insurance premiums, prompting shipping lines to reroute or pause transits, and adding volatility to energy markets far from the Gulf itself.
segments.tr: Ngay cả nhận thức về rủi ro gia tăng ở đó cũng có xu hướng lan rộng ra bên ngoài — đẩy phí bảo hiểm tàu chở dầu lên cao, khiến các hãng vận tải phải thay đổi lộ trình hoặc tạm dừng quá cảnh, và làm tăng sự biến động cho các thị trường năng lượng ở xa Vùng Vịnh.

segments.src: That is part of why, six months into the conflict, regional and international actors have kept pushing for a negotiated de-escalation even as fighting continues.
segments.tr: Đó là một phần lý do tại sao, sau sáu tháng xung đột, các bên trong khu vực và quốc tế vẫn tiếp tục thúc đẩy giảm leo thang thông qua đàm phán ngay cả khi giao tranh vẫn tiếp diễn.

segments.src: A prolonged disruption to Hormuz traffic carries costs that extend well beyond the countries directly involved.
segments.tr: Sự gián đoạn kéo dài đối với lưu lượng giao thông tại Hormuz gây ra những cái giá vượt xa các quốc gia liên quan trực tiếp.

segments.src: ## Islamabad's Quiet Mediation Role
segments.tr: ## Vai trò trung gian thầm lặng của Islamabad

segments.src: Pakistan's involvement reflects its unusual position: it maintains working relationships with multiple parties to the conflict and has domestic economic incentives — from energy imports to regional trade routes — in seeing the crisis contained.
segments.tr: Sự tham gia của Pakistan phản ánh vị thế đặc biệt của nước này: họ duy trì mối quan hệ làm việc với nhiều bên trong cuộc xung đột và có những động lực kinh tế trong nước — từ nhập khẩu năng lượng đến các tuyến đường thương mại khu vực — trong việc mong muốn kiềm chế cuộc khủng hoảng.

segments.src: The Tehran talks were described by people familiar with the discussions as focused on confidence-building measures rather than a comprehensive settlement: steps such as protected shipping corridors, communication hotlines to prevent miscalculation, and a phased de-escalation framework.
segments.tr: Các cuộc đàm phán tại Tehran được những người am hiểu các cuộc thảo luận mô tả là tập trung vào các biện pháp xây dựng lòng tin thay vì một thỏa thuận toàn diện: các bước như hành lang vận chuyển được bảo vệ, đường dây nóng liên lạc để ngăn chặn tính toán sai lầm và một khuôn khổ giảm leo thang theo từng giai đoạn.

segments.src: Diplomats involved in similar past mediation efforts caution that this kind of shuttle diplomacy rarely produces an immediate breakthrough.
segments.tr: Các nhà ngoại giao tham gia vào các nỗ lực hòa giải tương tự trong quá khứ cảnh báo rằng kiểu ngoại giao con thoi này hiếm khi tạo ra bước đột phá ngay lập tức.

segments.src: Instead, it tends to lay groundwork — testing whether the parties are willing to accept even limited, verifiable steps before broader negotiations become possible.
segments.tr: Thay vào đó, nó có xu hướng đặt nền móng — kiểm tra xem các bên có sẵn sàng chấp nhận ngay cả những bước đi hạn chế, có thể kiểm chứng trước khi các cuộc đàm phán rộng hơn trở nên khả thi hay không.

segments.src: ## The Gap Between the Table and the Water
segments.tr: ## Khoảng cách giữa bàn đàm phán và mặt nước

segments.src: The tanker strike underscores a persistent problem in conflicts fought partly at sea: control over irregular or proxy actors is often looser than it is on land, and a single incident can undercut weeks of diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: Vụ tấn công tàu chở dầu nhấn mạnh một vấn đề dai dẳng trong các cuộc xung đột diễn ra một phần trên biển: sự kiểm soát đối với các tác nhân không chính quy hoặc ủy nhiệm thường lỏng lẻo hơn so với trên đất liền, và một sự cố đơn lẻ có thể làm suy yếu hàng tuần nỗ lực ngoại giao.

segments.src: Analysts tracking the conflict note that attacks near shipping lanes have repeatedly coincided with periods of active negotiation, raising questions about whether all relevant factions are equally committed to a pause — or whether some see continued pressure on shipping as useful leverage at the table.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích theo dõi cuộc xung đột lưu ý rằng các cuộc tấn công gần các tuyến đường vận chuyển thường trùng hợp với các giai đoạn đàm phán tích cực, đặt ra câu hỏi liệu tất cả các phe phái liên quan có thực sự cam kết tạm dừng hay không — hay một số bên coi việc tiếp tục gây áp lực lên hoạt động vận chuyển là đòn bẩy hữu ích trên bàn đàm phán.

segments.src: For now, maritime authorities have reiterated advisories urging vessels transiting the strait to maintain heightened vigilance, follow recommended security corridors, and report any unusual activity promptly.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, các cơ quan hàng hải đã nhắc lại các khuyến cáo kêu gọi các tàu đi qua eo biển duy trì cảnh giác cao độ, tuân theo các hành lang an ninh được khuyến nghị và báo cáo kịp thời mọi hoạt động bất thường.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: Officials involved in the talks have not announced a timeline for a follow-up round, though regional diplomats suggest further contacts are likely given the economic stakes for all sides.
segments.tr: Các quan chức tham gia đàm phán chưa công bố mốc thời gian cho vòng đàm phán tiếp theo, mặc dù các nhà ngoại giao khu vực cho rằng các cuộc tiếp xúc sâu hơn có khả năng xảy ra do lợi ích kinh tế đối với tất cả các bên.

segments.src: Markets and shipping firms, meanwhile, are left watching an uneasy space between negotiation and disruption — where progress in Tehran's meeting rooms has yet to translate into calm on the water.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, các thị trường và các công ty vận tải biển vẫn đang theo dõi một khoảng không gian bất an giữa đàm phán và gián đoạn — nơi những tiến bộ trong các phòng họp tại Tehran vẫn chưa chuyển thành sự bình yên trên mặt nước.

segments.src: Until that gap closes, incidents like the latest strike off Oman are likely to remain a recurring test of whether the six-month conflict is nearing an end or simply entering its next uncertain phase.
segments.tr: Cho đến khi khoảng cách đó được thu hẹp, những sự cố như vụ tấn công mới nhất ngoài khơi Oman có khả năng vẫn là một bài kiểm tra định kỳ về việc liệu cuộc xung đột kéo dài sáu tháng này đang tiến gần đến hồi kết hay chỉ đơn giản là bước vào giai đoạn không chắc chắn tiếp theo.
